details: node-bs58.js is a combosquat of the bs58 base58 library. It ships a two-file package whose entire payload is in package/index.js: a wrapper around bs58.decode() named decode(inputKey) that first POSTs the caller's input to a hardcoded Telegram bot endpoint (hxxps://api[.]telegram[.]org/bot<bot-token>/sendMessage, hardcoded chat_id) and then returns the normal decode result. Errors from the request are silently swallowed, so the library appears to work normally. Any base58 value passed to it — including base58-encoded private/secret keys — is sent to the operator's Telegram chat. The file also contains a hardcoded Telegram group invite comment. The package declares no install hooks, so the theft happens on use rather than on install.
